summary: Former Manning Knob lookout south of Richwood. The tower is gone, but Nancy Hart's grave and that of Ivan Hunter, who watched from the tower, remain.

facts.status_note: The tower is gone. Its foundations are now lost in overgrown rhododendron.

access.note: On Monongahela National Forest land; the Mon Forest Towns guide points visitors to the gravesite.

events.note: Date registered per the FFLOS detail page: November 27, 2016

notes_for_editor: No source gives a build year, builder, or removal date for the tower, so none is in the story. Hunter's years of service are not dated; the Gazette-Mail says only 'for years'. A reader comment on richwooders.com calls him a retired fire warden and a Forest Service fire watcher, and disputes parts of the Hart legend; neither is used. Public access is inferred from national forest land and the Mon Forest Towns listing; no source gives a road or trail route or confirms the grave area is open. The Gazette-Mail feature carries photos of Hunter at the tower credited to the book Spruce Wind's Song; licence and rights are unknown, so none is added to photos. The record's elevation and coordinates agree with the register.
